tactics: Answer only from the passage; never add a fact it does not state.
If the passage does not contain the answer, say so plainly instead of guessing.
Copy names, numbers and titles exactly as the passage writes them.
When asked which passage, reply with the title and nothing else.
In a summary, cover each distinct fact once and add nothing.
